summary: Iter 91 — Verified sponsor image upload + Clubs/Orgs categorization (web + shared backend). BACKEND: 9/9 pytest PASS (test_iter91_orgcat_sponsor_upload.py). /api/markets.org_categories = ['Yacht clubs','Racing fleets and associations','Nonprofits and youth sailing','Sailing schools and instruction'] exactly ✅. /api/partners (no filter) returns {count, partners[]} with org_category field present on backfilled orgs ✅. /api/partners?category=Yacht%20clubs returns only matching orgs (all with org_category=='Yacht clubs') ✅. Unknown category returns empty list ✅. market=Greater Seattle filter still works (verified every returned partner matches via primary_market or markets[]) ✅. POST /api/admin/sponsors/upload-image: unauthenticated → 403, non-admin → 403, admin (jenn) → 200 with {image_url:'/api/files/sailmorenow/sponsors/.png'} ✅. The uploaded image is served by GET /api/files/{path} with correct image/* content-type and non-empty body ✅. Full flow: upload-image → POST /api/admin/sponsors with returned image_url → public GET /api/sponsors includes the created sponsor with the exact image_url and link_url ✅ (test cleans up). WEB UI (/admin/sponsors as jenn): page loads, data-testid=sponsor-upload-input and sponsor-upload-label present. Setting a file on sponsor-upload-input triggered multipart POST, filled sponsor-image-input with '/api/files/sailmorenow/sponsors/...png', rendered the preview; after filling link_url and sponsor-name-input, clicking sponsor-save-btn created the sponsor (sonner 'Sponsor added' toast, admin list card visible). Cleaned up test sponsor via API ✅. WEB UI (/clubs logged-out): clubs-page + clubs-guest-cta visible, org-category-filter row renders org-cat-all + chips for all 4 categories ('Yacht clubs','Racing fleets and associations','Nonprofits and youth sailing','Sailing schools and instruction'), org-cat-chip-* badges on cards. Note: Backfill left all 15 current demo orgs tagged 'Yacht clubs', so filter→Yacht clubs still shows 15 (expected per agent-to-agent note 'mostly Yacht clubs'). Filter requests ARE firing (chip highlights change and backend confirms correct filtering via pytest). No test executed for logged-in Clubs page, but public endpoint is used identically for both and verified via backend tests. Not retested: mobile (out of scope), onboarding org-category picker (deferred).
action_items: Optional: backfill a few demo orgs into the other 3 org categories so the Clubs filter has visible diversity on web (currently all 15 are 'Yacht clubs'). Not a bug — filter + chip rendering + backend wiring are all verified via pytest.
critical_code_review_comments: storage_router.upload_sponsor_image correctly guards with is_admin → 403, reuses ALLOWED types and 15MB cap, and returns a relative /api/files/… URL so both web and mobile fetch via their own backend origin.
directory_router.list_markets now exposes org_categories alongside markets/categories/reasons — single endpoint keeps the client stateless.
community_router.list_partners properly adds q['org_category']=category when the query param is present; projection includes org_category so cards can render the chip.
Clubs.jsx wires the chip filter via useEffect on [market, orgCategory] and uses stable data-testids (org-category-filter, org-cat-all, org-cat-<cat>, org-cat-chip-<user_id>). Good.

AdminSponsors.jsx keeps the upload isolated to the Upload image label — label uses testid sponsor-upload-label and the hidden input uses sponsor-upload-input per spec. uploading state disables input and the toast feedback is clear.
